research_summary: Erling Haaland felt better after missing GW28, but Pep Guardiola deferred the decision until after training.

sources.title: FPL Gameweek 29 team news: Tuesday's live injury updates and Haaland latest
sources.citation_excerpt: He feels much better but yesterday we didn't train. Now we have training, we will decide today.
sources.claim_text: Erling Haaland had improved after a knee issue but remained subject to a post-training decision before GW29.
